Sections.Heading: 1. You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands

Block.Title: Conviction
Block.Line: You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands.

Fields.Name: says
Fields.Text: You bring the taste. The stack brings the hands.

Fields.Name: opposite
Fields.Text: The tool decides the style and the context for you: a house prompt, a default voice, a template of how work should be done.

Fields.Name: broken_by
Fields.Text: Shipping a built-in persona or style that overrides what you wrote, or letting one fact live in two places, so that an agent reads the stale copy.

Runs.Text: What an agent cannot supply is what makes the work yours: your taste, your vision, your context from outside the screen. The owner's point is not to write down how he works but to bring his taste and his context while working at the high level (

Sections.Heading: 2. Delegating is a craft, not a prompt

Block.Line: Delegating is a craft, not a prompt.

Fields.Text: Delegating is a craft, not a prompt.

Fields.Name: opposite

Sections.Heading: 3. Rules live in the world, not in the agent

Block.Title: Conviction
Block.Line: Rules live in the world, not in the agent.

Fields.Name: says
Fields.Text: Rules live in the world, not in the agent.

Fields.Name: opposite

Runs.Text: An agent cannot break your computer: it is not on it.

Block.Title: Conviction
Block.Line: Declared, never improvised.

Fields.Name: says
Fields.Text: Declared, never improvised.

Fields.Name: opposite
Fields.Text: Configure by hand, as you go, and forget what you did.

Fields.Name: broken_by
Fields.Text: A setting reachable only by a click with no file behind it, or a state the stack holds that no file explains.

Runs.Text: , set up before its first command.

Block.Title: Conviction
Block.Line: Done means proven.

Fields.Name: says
Fields.Text: Done means proven.

Fields.Text: “It seems to work”, said by whoever did the work.

Runs.Text: A request comes back with its proof, or it does not come back as done.

Block.Title: Conviction
Block.Line: Taste is a system.

Fields.Name: says

Sections.Heading: 7. The stack learns. You don't repeat yourself

A space leans on the ones before it and never needs the ones after. Agents runs in machines Machines can build; in the OS space, Wiki is what agents read, Specs proves the work against what you and Wiki asked for, Design turns your taste into rules the work is held to, and the OS is the one place you steer from.
